_readme.what: Playtest feedback from situations.html: one verdict and note a row -- an eyes row (js/eyes.js: built, not yet seen) or a story situation (?at=<id>, js/situations.js).
_readme.fold_back: Fold every eyes row noted here that is still live in js/eyes.js (a folded row is already cut, so nothing folds twice; previous_save and new_since_last_save only hint at what is new -- RULED 10-15); a story situation note folds when its `at` is after the save of the last ear file folded. An eyes row noted at all is SEEN: a `seen` line in PATCHLOG.md with the note verbatim, and the row cut from js/eyes.js whatever the verdict (a fix that wants another look writes a fresh row). Broken and unclear become the fix list (in the lane its pt names); too hard / too easy are tuning; notes are the tester's words, verbatim.
